messages:
alex: addressed the review comments from yesterday (split the flaky test into a separate suite, clarified the error handling docs, and added a short migration note). PTAL when you have a minute. I also left a note about rollback semantics in the runbooks. Can someone grab the merge custodian role for canary? I can schedule the canary tomorrow morning.

priya: thanks alex — quick glance now. did you update the CHANGELOG entry? we need that for release notes.

alex: yep, added a single-line CHANGELOG under "unreleased" and included the migration note. also added a smoke script in tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh so ops can reproduce locally.

priya: nice. can you paste the smoke command here so i can run it quickly?

alex: sure: ```./tools/smoke/run_smoke.sh --cluster staging --job quick --timeout 300```

daniel: @alex @priya i can be custodian for the merge if priya is okay with the timing. will watch canary and roll back if anything spikes.

priya: thanks @daniel, appreciated. i can run the smoke now and confirm.

alex: smoke command output (short): ```SUMMARY: 12/12 checks passed
latency: p95=120ms
no obvious errors in logs```

priya: ran it here too — same. LGTM from my side. :+1:

merge-bot: auto-checks: all CI jobs green, changelog present, license header verified. ready-for-canary tag applied.

daniel: i'll kick off the canary at 09:00 PT tomorrow and will post status updates in #incidents if anything looks off. who should i ping if we need an immediate rollback?

priya: ping me and alex first. if we need infra help, escalate to eng-sre.

alex: thanks all — assigning @daniel as merge custodian. PTAL done. :shipit:
